# Niger Imports Algerian Fuel by Tanker Truck to Ease Gasoline Shortage

Niger received a convoy of tanker trucks from Algeria in Agadez after banning exports of super gasoline and diesel. The shortage highlights the limits of the Zinder refinery and turmoil at SONIDEP.
